title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the Mobile Legends Bang Bang Third Place match between FUT Esports and Rakuzan in the BetBoom Rise of Legends Playoffs, initially scheduled for November 15, 2026 at 9:45 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "FUT Esports" if FUT Esports win Game 1 against Rakuzan.

This market will resolve to "Rakuzan" if Rakuzan win Game 1 against FUT Esports.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Game 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Game 1. 

If Game 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 29, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of November 15, 2026 at 9:45 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://liquipedia.net/mobilelegends/Main_Page. However, if https://liquipedia.net/mobilelegends/Main_Page has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
